exact_frontier.theorem: For every feasible h, (C_A,C_F)=(h,min(m,F_b(n,h))) is constructively attainable.
exact_frontier.mechanism: protected deepest child-0 spine plus private opposite-target pairs

sharp_lift.general_form: max robust statewise margin = max[U(C_A)-U(C_F)] = max_h[U(h)-U(I_h)] for finite nonincreasing U
sharp_lift.payoff_cost_ceiling: K_crit^robust = max_h[U(h)-U(I_h)] for positive net value in every represented world

interpretation.main: Natural history re-ranks an exact finite structural frontier; the ratio-optimal architecture need not maximize robust statewise biological value.
interpretation.correction: Unbounded C_F/C_A does not imply unbounded robust value. Expected branchwise value is a separate estimand.
interpretation.comparator_ceiling: The result is relative to the declared universal fixed comparator unless another architecture class is modeled.
interpretation.robust_expected_boundary: The sharp envelope is exact for worst-state/distribution-free value. It is not an upper bound on positive expected selection under a particular nonuniform world distribution.

prior_art_boundary.candidate_distinctive_result: sharp composition of the fixed-(n,m,b) guaranteed-resolution frontier with arbitrary monotone completion value, attained by the same constructive witnesses

claim_ceiling: The recorded green tests validate the exact structural frontier and robust guarantee-level envelope. Expected evolutionary value additionally requires world frequencies and branch-specific completion times and is not bounded above by this robust ceiling.
